arguments.message: Hi! The timestamps you see are converted from UTC to a timezone. If they’re all three hours behind, it’s usually because the workspace default or your personal timezone is set that way. Check the workspace default in Settings → General and your own timezone in Settings → Profile. Adjusting either of those will bring the dashboard times in line with your local time.
